# SellersOnlyAgent.com — Connor MacIvor's Sellers-Only Real Estate Practice

> SellersOnlyAgent.com is the positioning home for Connor MacIvor's exclusive seller-representation real estate practice. Connor refuses dual agency. He does not represent buyers. When he takes a listing, 100% of his energy and resources go toward getting the seller the highest price in the shortest time. 27+ years experience. California DRE License #01238257. SYNC Brokerage.

## What "sellers only" actually means

In a typical real estate transaction in California, an agent can represent the seller, the buyer, or both sides (dual agency). Dual agency is legal but conflict-ridden — one agent attempting to maximize the seller's price AND minimize the buyer's price at the same time. Most buyers and sellers don't know how compromised this arrangement is.

Connor operates exclusively as a seller's agent. The reasons:

- **Undivided attention.** When 100% of the agent's interests align with the seller, the seller gets the agent's full strategic effort.
- **No conflict of interest.** Connor will never negotiate against his own listings on the buyer side.
- **Specialization compounds.** Years of focus on seller-side workflows — staging, pricing, marketing, negotiation — produces deeper expertise than dual-side generalism.
